description: A file at any commit (git show <rev>:<path>) from the clone. An unknown name or path is an error, never a silent HEAD. At most 2000 lines a call: start_line/end_line pick them, total_lines gives the length, cut=true says more follow. Lines numbered with a tab unless numbered=false. sha (cite it with path and lines) and ref; a binary file returns a note.

end_line.description: Last line, inclusive (default the end, at most start_line + 1999)

numbered.description: Number lines with a tab (default true); false: exact bytes

name: git_show_file
